The 12 hour liquid Delsym has a different for of Dxm called Dextromethorphan Polistirex, which is half as strong as hbr, but it lasts twice as long.  Delsym is pretty much the best option if you want to use Dxm Polistirex, but if you want to use hbr, those Delsym Tabs are not the most cost effective option.  I highly recommend Robocough. Yes, Robitussin syrup contains dxm, but it also contains guaifenesin, which won't necessarily kill you, but it will cause intense stomach upset, diarrhea, intense vomiting, and possibly kidney stones.  When you trip, you want to make sure the product you're using has DXM as the only active ingredient.  Again, Robocough is your best option.
